name: Yoink — Grab any page as HTML for Figma
description: Point at any element or grab the whole page, and yoink it as self-contained HTML — ready to paste into Figma via html.to.design.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'
